title: Patient Falls from Sixth Floor of PGI Hospital in Chandigarh
summary: A patient fell from the sixth floor of the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGI) hospital in Chandigarh. The patient was admitted to the ICU with a serious condition due to lack of funds for surgery. The government said that the hospital's emergency services were overwhelmed, while the opposition alleged that the hospital's administration was responsible for the incident. Police claimed that they received multiple calls about the incident and responded promptly. The hospital's management stated that they were working to provide better security measures.
summary_points: A patient fell from the sixth floor of PGI Hospital in Chandigarh.
